label: christmastwo2
title_zh: 靠谱又绝对正牌的 Imani 公主

lines.en: label christmastwo2:
scene christmastwomaid1
: I’ve gotta admit, this is not what I was expecting for a first night out with my new amigos, but I am all about it.
lines.zh: : 我得承认，跟我这两位新朋友的第一晚出去玩，跟我想象的可不太一样，不过我超级买账。

lines.en: : I’ve never been to a maid cafe before so I’m kinda like, fighting off the culture shock right now, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我从没来过女仆咖啡厅，所以现在大概是正在跟文化冲击搏斗之类的。

lines.en: : Your surname is Imai. Aren’t you half Japanese?
lines.zh: : 你姓 Imai。你不是有一半日本血统吗？

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid2
: How can you be so sure that’s my real last name and that I’m not just trying to trick you into thinking I’m amigo material?
lines.zh: : 你怎么能那么确定那就是我真姓，而不是我在骗你，好让你以为我有当朋友的资格？

lines.en: : I can’t. I was just asking a question.
lines.zh: : 我不能确定。我只是问个问题而已。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid3
: Well, fine! If you’re going to be so pushy about it, yes! I am half Japanese!
lines.zh: : 行吧，行吧！你要是这么刨根问底，那好！我是有一半日本血统！

lines.en: : I’ve returned home because I’m actually a princess and I’m here to collect my inheritance.
lines.zh: : 我这次回来，其实是因为我是一位公主，回来继承我的遗产的。

lines.en: : Right. So then why are you working as a teacher?
lines.zh: : 好。那你怎么会去当老师？

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid4
: Where are {i}you{/i} from Wakana?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}是哪里人，Wakana？

lines.en: : You really need to stop dodging my questions by asking questions to someone else. It has happened two times already today and I would be lying if I said I wasn’t annoyed.
lines.zh: : 你真的别再用「问别人问题」来躲我的问题了。今天都发生两次了，我说不觉得烦那是在撒谎。

lines.en: : I’m from...my apartment.
lines.zh: : 我来自……我的公寓。

lines.en: : Cool cool cool cool cool cool cool. And where did you get that tea? No one’s come to the table yet.
lines.zh: : 好好好好好好好。那这茶你从哪儿弄来的？都还没人到桌边来过呢。

lines.en: : I texted my significant other and had her prepare it for me beforehand. The walk here was quite cold and I didn’t want to just sit around waiting for tea to brew while freezing to death.
lines.zh: : 我给我的另一半发了短信，让她提前给我泡好的。过来的路上挺冷的，我可不想干坐着等茶煮好，一边等一边冻死。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid5
: Non-literal death, of course. I’m contractually obligated to say that now so no one thinks I’m going to kill myself.
lines.zh: : 当然，是非字面意义上的死。我现在有合同在身，必须这么说，免得别人以为我要自杀。

lines.en: : Well, thank you for offering some to us, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 嗯，谢谢你愿意分我们一点，Wakana。

lines.en: : Over my non-literally dead body. Get your own.
lines.zh: : 想都别想，除非从我非字面意义上的尸体上跨过去。自己买去。

lines.en: : So, you come here often, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那么，你常来这儿吗，老师？

lines.en: : Are you hitting on me right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在跟我搭讪吗？

lines.en: : Do you {i}want{/i} me to be hitting on you right now?
lines.zh: : 你{i}想{/i}让我现在跟你搭讪吗？

lines.en: : I don’t {i}not{/i} want you to be hitting on me right now.
lines.zh: : 我也不是{i}不{/i}想让你现在跟我搭讪。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. You mean to tell me that one of the like, seven dudes in Kumon-mi is single and doesn’t have anyone who’d get pissed off at him for flirting with some foreign girl?
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。你是想告诉我，Kumon-mi 那大概七个男的里，有一个是单身，而且勾搭外国姑娘也不会有人冲他发火？

lines.en: : I mean, the first part of that is true, but not so much the second. Also, there are a lot more than seven men left in this city.
lines.zh: : 嗯，前半句是真的，后半句就不太对了。而且这座城市剩下的男人可比七个多多了。

lines.en: : Well make sure to have some of ‘em sign up on Tinder at your next super-secret man meeting because I haven’t had anyone to swipe for in ages now.
lines.zh: : 那记得让你那场超级秘密的男人聚会里，挑几个去注册 Tinder 啊，我都好久没得滑了。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid6
: And to think that just an hour ago you were accusing the two of {i}us{/i} of having a sexual relationship...
lines.zh: : 想想就在一个小时前，你还在指控{i}我们俩{/i}有性关系……

lines.en: : A what now?
lines.zh: : 什么现在？

lines.en: : Uhh...Wakana?
lines.zh: : 呃……Wakana？

lines.en: Oh, comedic timing. You never let me down.
lines.zh: 哦，绝妙的喜剧时机。你从不让我失望。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid7
: Hello, my precious and forgiving kitten with short term memory loss. I love you.
lines.zh: : 你好，我珍贵的、宽容的、患有短期失忆的小猫咪。我爱你。

lines.en: : How are you feeling? Do you need anything? Is the tea good? We’re out of the kind you like, so I had to use one you’ve never had before and-
lines.zh: : 你感觉怎么样？需要什么吗？茶好喝吗？你喜欢的那种卖完了，所以我只好用一种你从没喝过的，然后——

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid8
: I’m fine, my darling. I do not need anything. The tea is nice.
lines.zh: : 我很好，亲爱的。我什么也不需要。茶很好喝。

lines.en: : Awwwwww, my best friend is so cute when she’s in love.
lines.zh: : 呜哇哇哇，我最好的朋友恋爱的样子可真可爱。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid9
: {i}Best{/i} friend? We’ve known each other for roughly one hour.
lines.zh: : {i}最好{/i}的朋友？我们才认识了大概一个小时吧。

lines.en: : And it’s been one of the greatest hours of my life.
lines.zh: : 而这是我人生中最棒的一个小时之一。

lines.en: : Umm...who might you be, Princess?
lines.zh: : 呃……请问您是，公主殿下？

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid10
: Ha! I told you I was a princess! And you didn’t believe me!
lines.zh: : 哈！我说了我是公主吧！你还不信！

lines.en: : It’s just what the maids call their female customers. Women are princesses and men are masters.
lines.zh: : 那只是女仆们对女顾客的称呼。女生是公主，男生是主人。

lines.en: : Also, you respond to Uta-chan when she speaks to you, damn it.
lines.zh: : 还有，Uta-chan 跟你说话的时候，你要回话，该死的。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid11
: Th-Thank you, Master...
lines.zh: : 谢、谢谢，主人……

lines.en: : Hey, can we talk in the hall for a minute?
lines.zh: : 嘿，能借一步到走廊说两句吗？

lines.en: : Hm? Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 嗯？出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : Well, not {i}wrong{/i}...just...
lines.zh: : 嗯，不是{i}出事{/i}……只是……

lines.en: : Can you just come with me for a second?
lines.zh: : 你就跟我来一下下好吗？

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid12
: Yes. But I am bringing my tea and you can not stop me.
lines.zh: : 好。但我要端着我的茶，你拦不住我。

lines.en: : That’s fine...
lines.zh: : 没关系……

lines.en: : I’ll be back momentarily, but chances are you won’t even notice I’m gone.
lines.zh: : 我马上就回来，不过你们大概根本不会注意到我不在了。

lines.en: : That’s not another jab at me for never visiting you, is it?
lines.zh: : 这又不是在暗讽我从没去看过你，对吧？

lines.en: : {i}You won’t even notice I’m gone.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你们根本不会注意到我不在了。{/i}

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid13
Wakana and Osako step out into the hallway and, in other news, Uta probably thinks I have a tenth girlfriend now or something.
lines.zh: Wakana 和 Osako 走到走廊上；另外插播一条新闻：Uta 大概现在以为我又多了第十个女朋友之类的。

lines.en: : So, uhh...who are you? I thought I overheard something about Tinder?
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……你是谁？我好像听到什么 Tinder？

lines.en: : Are you two...you know...
lines.zh: : 你们俩是……你知道的……

lines.en: : Know what?
lines.zh: : 知道什么？

lines.en: : Please tell me in vivid detail so I can say no and then laugh at you and make you feel embarrassed.
lines.zh: : 请绘声绘色地告诉我，好让我拒绝你，然后笑话你，让你觉得难堪。

lines.en: : It’s not a date, Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 这不是约会，Uta-chan。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid14
: Of course it’s not a date, Uta-chan. Sensei would never date anyone ever because he knows it would make me so sad that I might accidentally tie him up and not let him leave home ever again.
lines.zh: : 当然不是约会，Uta-chan。老师是永远不会跟任何人约会的，因为他知道那会让我难过到可能一不小心把他绑起来，然后永远不让他出门。

lines.en: : Yeah, I hate when I get sad and accidentally do that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我一难过就一不小心干出那种事，真讨厌。

lines.en: : Hey, Ami. You’re working late tonight.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Ami。你今晚加班啊。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid15
: I’m picking up extra hours so I can buy presents for all of my friends since my uncle doesn’t give me an allowance anymore.
lines.zh: : 我在多接几个小时的班，好给所有朋友买礼物，因为我叔叔已经不给我零花钱了。

lines.en: : Also, who is this girl and why are you with her?
lines.zh: : 还有，这女孩是谁，你为什么跟她在一起？

lines.en: : This is Imani. She was filling in for Wakana while she was in the hospital.
lines.zh: : 这位是 Imani。Wakana 住院期间是她来代课的。

lines.en: : That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : Oh, and I’m also your new student teacher.
lines.zh: : 哦，而且我还是你们的新实习老师。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid16
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Surprise!
lines.zh: : 惊不惊喜！

lines.en: : I’ve known since Monday. This just seemed like a good spot to break the news.
lines.zh: : 我星期一就知道了。只是觉得在这儿宣布正合适。

lines.en: : I was holding it in so I could find the best chance to use it for dramatic effect.
lines.zh: : 我一直憋着，就想找个最好的时机，好制造戏剧效果。

lines.en: : Well, you...certainly picked a time, alright.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你……确实挑了个时候，没错。

lines.en: Is Imani really going to be a student teacher for my class?
lines.zh: Imani 真的要当我们班的实习老师吗？

lines.en: What...exactly is that going to mean for my “methods” of just having everyone do whatever they want all the time?
lines.zh: 那对我那套「让大家想干嘛就干嘛」的教学「方法」来说，到底意味着什么？

lines.en: Don’t tell me she’s going to want me to actually {i}teach{/i} now, is she?
lines.zh: 别告诉我她会要求我真的开始{i}讲课{/i}，会吗？

lines.en: : Wait, why are we getting a student teacher? None of the other classes have one.
lines.zh: : 等等，为什么我们会有实习老师？其他班都没有啊。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid17
: You know, it might be hard to believe since you seem like a really smart girl who’s benefited greatly from my new Senpai’s teachings, but the school just thinks he kind of sucks for some reason.
lines.zh: : 你可能很难相信——毕竟你看起来像个非常聪明的女孩，还从我这位新来的前辈这儿受益匪浅——但学校就是觉得他有点烂，不知为什么。

lines.en: : Hey. That’s not a fair evaluation of my character.
lines.zh: : 嘿。这评价对我的人品可不公平。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid18
: No, it kind of is.
lines.zh: : 不，某种程度上挺公平的。

lines.en: : Also, Uta is nowhere close to really smart, so I hope your teaching is a little better than your judgement or it will be like nothing’s changed at all.
lines.zh: : 还有，Uta 根本算不上真聪明，所以我希望你的教学水平比你的眼光好一点，否则一切就都跟没变过一样了。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid19
: Ami-chan, why must you hurt me so? To be called dumb by a fellow dummy makes me feel even...dumber.
lines.zh: : Ami-chan，你为什么非要伤我的心？被同为笨蛋的人叫作笨蛋，只会让我觉得更……笨。

lines.en: : Wait, is dumber even a word? Or is it more dumb?
lines.zh: : 等等，「dumber」到底算不算一个词啊？还是该说「more dumb」？

lines.en: : Oooookay! So maybe you’re not that smart! But that’s just all the more reason to rely on me!
lines.zh: : 好——吧！那也许你确实没那么聪明！但这反而更有理由依赖我了！

lines.en: : But what if we don’t want to rely on you?
lines.zh: : 可要是我们不想依赖你呢？

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid20
: Hm? What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你这话是什么意思？

lines.en: : What I mean is that our class is kind of...different.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我们班有点……不一样。

lines.en: : Sensei has a very...unique way of teaching, and having another teacher around, especially an attractive one,
lines.zh: : 老师的教学方式非常……独特，而身边再多一个老师，尤其还是个漂亮的——

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid21
: Hey, I get it. Change is scary and blah blah blah listen to me, I’m an adult.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我懂。改变是很可怕的，吧啦吧啦吧啦，总之听我说，我可是个成年人。

lines.en: : I’m not going to just waltz into class tomorrow and-
lines.zh: : 我不会明天一早就大摇大摆地走进教室，然后——

lines.en: : Wait, tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 等等，明天？

lines.en: : Yeah, I start tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 对，我明天开始。

lines.en: : But Wakana doesn’t come back until Monday.
lines.zh: : 可 Wakana 星期一才回来啊。

lines.en: : Well then I guess her students are getting a day off. Can I finish now?
lines.zh: : 那她的学生就当放一天假好了。我能说完了吗？

lines.en: : What I was saying is that I’m not going to just waltz into class tomorrow and change the way you guys have been doing stuff all year.
lines.zh: : 我刚说的是，我不会明天一早就大摇大摆地走进教室，去改变你们一整年以来的做事方式。

lines.en: : I’ll just be around to help anyone who needs it or wants it while, at the same time, keeping Sensei out of trouble.
lines.zh: : 我只是在旁边待着，帮任何需要或想要帮助的人，同时，让老师别惹麻烦。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid22
: What’s Makoto gonna do then? Those are like, all of her favorite things.
lines.zh: : 那 Makoto 要干嘛？那些可都是她最喜欢的事啊。

lines.en: : Hopefully, she’ll just die.
lines.zh: : 希望她干脆死了算了。

lines.en: : Ami, come on.
lines.zh: : Ami，别这样。

lines.en: : Sensei, I don’t want a student teacher. I want you and only you. Forever and ever and ever and ever and ever and-
lines.zh: : 老师，我不要实习老师。我只要你，只只要你。永远永远永远永远永远，还有——

lines.en: : We get it, Ami. You love your [uncle].
lines.zh: : 知道了，Ami。你爱你的[uncle]。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid23
: And ever and ever and ever and-
lines.zh: : 还有永远永远永远——

lines.en: : Man, you get to teach your {i}niece{/i}? That’s awesome. I wish I got to teach my family.
lines.zh: : 天哪，你能教自己的{i}侄女{/i}？太酷了。我真希望我也能教自己家人。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid24
: Is your family in Japan too, Princess Imani?
lines.zh: : 你的家人也在日本吗，Imani 公主？

lines.en: : Nah, they’re still over in Ghana doing Ghana stuff. How about you, Uta-chan? I’d say you look like you come from a big family, but I’ve already been wrong about you once soooo-
lines.zh: : 没呢，他们还在加纳干着加纳的事。你呢，Uta-chan？我本来想说你看着像是来自一个大家庭，可我已经看错过你一次了，所——

lines.en: Oh, good. Here we go.
lines.zh: 哦，好。来了。

lines.en: : Just my mom and dad and my brother, but my brother is in jail. I had a grandpa too but he died of terminal cancer.
lines.zh: : 只有我爸妈和我哥，不过我哥在坐牢。我以前还有个爷爷，但他得晚期癌症死了。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid25
: Man, maid cafes are fucking dope. Where else will people just dump their traumas all over me before I can even order food?
lines.zh: : 天哪，女仆咖啡厅真他妈酷毙了。还有什么地方能让人在我点餐之前，就把自己的心理创伤一股脑倒给我？

lines.en: : Honestly? Pretty much everywhere around here. I’m learning that it’s kind of just a thing people do in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 说实话？这一带基本哪儿都是。我算明白了，在 Kumon-mi，人们就是爱干这种事。

lines.en: : You think the brave and adorable Uta-chan would be traumatized by something like watching a loved one slowly fade away into nothingness?
lines.zh: : 你觉得勇敢又可爱的 Uta-chan，会被「看着挚爱之人慢慢消散成虚无」这种事留下创伤吗？

lines.en: : That seems like a pretty fair thing to be traumatized by, Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 被那种事留下创伤，好像也挺正常的吧，Uta-chan。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid26
: Tsk tsk tsk. Oh, Master. You don’t know the first thing about Uta-chan, do you?
lines.zh: : 啧啧啧。哎呀，主人。你对 Uta-chan 一无所知，是吧？

lines.en: : I know that you lure people into karaoke booths in order to prey upon them.
lines.zh: : 我知道你会把人骗进卡拉 OK 包厢，好对他们下手。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid27
: Th-th-th-th-that wasn’t Uta-chan! That was normal Uta! And she wasn’t preying on anybody! She just got caught in the moment!
lines.zh: : 才、才、才、才、那不是 Uta-chan！那是普通的 Uta！而且她也没有对谁下手！她只是一时上头！

lines.en: : And ever and ever and ever and-
lines.zh: : 还有永远永远永远——

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid28
: I suddenly feel like I’m supposed to be suspicious of something.
lines.zh: : 我突然觉得，自己似乎应该对什么事起疑心。

lines.en: : Well, looks to me like {i}somebody{/i} must have a {i}pretty{/i} lively classroom if these two girls are a sign of things to come.
lines.zh: : 我看啊，如果这两个女孩就是未来的预兆，那{i}你{/i}的教室一定{i}相当{/i}热闹。

lines.en: : Honestly, these two are on the easier side.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这两位还算好搞的。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid29
: Rude. I'm not easy at all.
lines.zh: : 好过分。我可一点都不随便。

lines.en: : Not like that, Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 不是那个意思，Uta-chan。

lines.en: : Well, hey. I’m up for pretty much whatever. It’s not like I’ve got anything else going on in Kumon-mi anyway.
lines.zh: : 嗯，嘿。我基本什么都愿意试。反正我在 Kumon-mi 也没别的事可做。

lines.en: : I’m looking forward to working with you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 期待和你共事，老师。

lines.en: : Imani, you’re probably going to question what I mean by this, but I just need you to go along with it when I say that there will be minimal work involved.
lines.zh: : Imani，你大概会对我这话提出质疑，但当我说「工作量极少」的时候，你只需要配合我就行。

lines.en: : You know, I think I’m starting to figure out why they shoved me in your class instead of somebody else’s.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我开始明白为什么他们把我塞进你的班、而不是别人的班了。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll confirm that belief on your first full day of class.
lines.zh: : 我相信，等你上完第一天完整的课，就会印证这个想法。

lines.en: : But, in the meantime, we should probably order something since we’ve now been here for...quite a while.
lines.zh: : 不过在此期间，我们大概该点些东西了，毕竟我们已经在这儿待了……挺久了。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid30
: Oh! Umm...Master? Would it be okay if I pulled you aside for a second? I just had a quick little question for you and stuff.
lines.zh: : 哦！呃……主人？能不能借一步说话？我有个小小的、很快的问题想问你之类的。

lines.en: : Sure, but we should probably try to stay away from wherever Osako and Wakana went. They’ve been gone for a long time and I think they might be making out or something.
lines.zh: : 当然，不过我们最好离 Osako 和 Wakana 去的地方远点。她们已经去了好久了，我觉得她们可能正在接吻什么的。

lines.en: scene black
I leave the table and Ami immediately begins interrogating Imani about all sorts of topics that I’m sure won’t make her feel strange or unwelcome at all.
lines.zh: 我离开座位，Ami 立刻开始就各种话题盘问 Imani——我相信那些问题绝对不会让她觉得奇怪或不受欢迎。

lines.en: That’s not me being sarcastic either. I’ve only known her for a short period of time, but I feel like it’s very hard to throw Imani off of her game.
lines.zh: 这也不是我在反讽。虽然认识她的时间不长，但我觉得 Imani 是那种很难被扰乱阵脚的人。

lines.en: And while having her around {i}all{/i} the time sounds like it could become problematic in a...variety of ways, I’m not going to immediately just write it off.
lines.zh: 虽然让她{i}整天{/i}待在身边，听起来可能会在各种……方面变得麻烦，但我不打算立刻就把这事先否定掉。

lines.en: For all I know, the two of us could get along really well.
lines.zh: 说不定，我们俩会相处得非常好。

lines.en: Also, she didn’t seem entirely opposed to the threesome idea earlier, and I see that as a huge plus.
lines.zh: 而且，她对之前那个三人行的点子似乎也不是完全排斥，我认为这是个巨大的加分项。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid31
: So...what’s up? What did you need to ask me about?
lines.zh: : 那么……怎么了？你想问我什么？

lines.en: : Well, I...
: I was just wondering if...tomorrow after school...
lines.zh: : 我就想问问……明天放学后……

lines.en: : You could maybe like...
lines.zh: : 你能不能……就是……

lines.en: : Come over?
lines.zh: : 来我家？

lines.en: For entirely unknown reasons, it suddenly becomes harder to stand.
lines.zh: 出于完全不明的原因，我突然站不太稳了。

lines.en: : I will go anywhere for you, Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 我愿为你去任何地方，Uta-chan。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid32
: Not...for Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 不是……为了 Uta-chan。

lines.en: : For normal Uta.
lines.zh: : 是为了普通的 Uta。

lines.en: : Normal Uta?
lines.zh: : 普通的 Uta？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: You...do realize how this sounds, right?
lines.zh: : 你……知道这话听起来像什么吧？

lines.en: : What if I told you...I already called my parents?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你……我已经跟我爸妈说过了呢？

lines.en: : Well, I’d first confirm that you didn’t tell them who I am or where I live. But after that, I’d-
lines.zh: : 那我得先确认你没告诉他们我是谁、我住哪儿。但在那之后，我会——

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid33
: Uhh- actually! I forgot to mention that Io is going to be there too. And that...well, she’s the one who wanted me to ask you to come over in the first place.
lines.zh: : 呃——对了！我忘了说了，Io 也会在。而且……嗯，其实是她想让我请你过来的。

lines.en: : I just...went about asking in a really weird way, I guess. Hahaha...
lines.zh: : 我只是……问的方式有点奇怪，我猜。哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Yet again, lured into a false state of arousal by a tiny girl in a maid costume.
lines.zh: 又一次，被一个穿着女仆装的小女孩骗进了虚假的性奋状态。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid34
: So...even if it wasn’t Io and it really was just me...you’d come?
lines.zh: : 所以……就算不是 Io 的事，真的只是我……你也会来？

lines.en: : Is that even a question? Of course.
lines.zh: : 这还算问题吗？当然会。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid35
: I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : Why are you being so weird all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然这么奇怪？

lines.en: : Weird in what way?
lines.zh: : 奇怪在哪儿？

lines.en: : Weird in the fact that you’re not mindlessly flirting with me and that you’re blushing like you’ve been in a sauna for three hours.
lines.zh: : 奇怪在你没有没完没了地跟我调情，还脸红得像在桑拿房里待了三个小时。

lines.en: : I guess my face does feel a little hot...
lines.zh: : 我觉得脸确实有点烫……

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid36
: B-But that’s just because I {i}wanted{/i} you to think I was embarrassed about asking! I mean, why would I feel nervous about asking you to come over when you’ve been over so many times before?!
lines.zh: : 可、可那只是因为我{i}想{/i}让你以为我不好意思问！我是说，你之前都来过那么多次了，我邀请你过来有什么好紧张的？！

lines.en: : That would be totally weird! And it’s not like I have any intention of letting you put your hands on me or anything!
lines.zh: : 那也太奇怪了！而且我也绝对没打算让你把手放到我身上之类的！

lines.en: : Okay, that’s getting back on track. But you still seem a little off and-
lines.zh: : 好，这话题算是回到正轨了。不过你看起来还是有点不对劲，而且——

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid37
: A-Are you coming or not?! Io made you a Christmas present and it’s taking up too much space in our dorm!
lines.zh: : 你、你到底来不来？！Io 给你做了个圣诞礼物，它在我们宿舍里太占地方了！

lines.en: : Space? What space?
lines.zh: : 地方？什么地方？

lines.en: : That’s exactly the problem! I had to crawl under a table just to get to my skirt this morning!
lines.zh: : 问题就在这儿！我今天早上为了拿裙子，还得爬到桌子底下去！

lines.en: : Have you considered, you know, storing your clothes somewhere that isn’t directly on the floor?
lines.zh: : 你有没有考虑过，比如，把衣服放到不是直接摊在地上的地方？

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid38
: Nonsense. The floor is where clothes are {i}supposed{/i} to go. If that wasn’t the case, it wouldn’t be so big.
lines.zh: : 胡说。衣服{i}本来就该{/i}放地上。要不是这样，地板干嘛要那么大。

lines.en: : I’ll make sure to drop by, Uta. Whether or not Io is there.
lines.zh: : 我会顺路过去的，Uta。不管 Io 在不在。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid35
: Cool...yeah.
: Io will be really happy.
lines.zh: : Io 会很高兴的。

lines.en: : And you?
lines.zh: : 那你呢？

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid34
: Me?
: Yeah. You’re the one asking. I’m not just dropping by to make Io happy.
lines.zh: : 对啊。是你来邀请我的。我可不是只为了让 Io 高兴才顺路过去。

lines.en: scene christmastwomaid36
: That’s for me to know and you to find out!
lines.zh: : 那是秘密，你自己去发现吧！

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I...I don’t know!
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道！

lines.en: : I’ll see you tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 明天见！

lines.en: scene black
: But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : We still haven’t ordered...
lines.zh: : 我们还没点单呢……

$ christmastwo2 = True
{i}Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}
